title: Bounded-below complexes of injectives are K-injective
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and $I$ a cochain complex of $\mathcal A$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] which is bounded below (there is $d\in\mathbf Z$ with $I^n=0$ for all $n<d$) and whose terms $I^n$ are injective objects [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then $I$ is K-injective (for every acyclic complex $A$ the complex $\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(A,I)$ is acyclic, as in [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions] with $\mathcal A$ in place of $\Mod(T_{\Et},R)$).

mathlib_searches.query: bounded below cochain complex of injective objects is K-injective

mathlib_searches.results: CochainComplex.isKInjective_of_injective (L) (d), with [L.IsStrictlyGE d] and injective terms.

mathlib_searches.query: bounded below complex with injective terms is K-injective

mathlib_searches.results: Exact theorem at lines 133-134; hypotheses are strict lower bound and injectivity of every term.

mathlib_match.how: Exact theorem: a strictly bounded-below cochain complex with injective terms is K-injective; declaration begins at line 133 and its hypotheses continue at line 134.
